name: Joseph’s shield at the ruined farm

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic quest sequence · exact date unknown

summary: A separate relic leads to Gahrron’s Withering, where the quest locates Joseph Redpath’s broken shield near a ruined farm. Its damage speaks to the village captain’s remembered role, but the object alone cannot tell how or when it was lost. Here the Plaguelands narrow from the fortified town to a leaning barn, broken fence and pallid field: a rural clue, not a complete account of the battle.
